name: Shimano seven-speed cassette (E group)
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed seven-speed E-group 12–28T cassette, including spacers; lockring inclusion is assumed under the catalogue guidelines. The 1991 DX and LX tables both give 325 g for this E-group configuration, distinct from the existing I-group 13–23T record.
